# Synthetic face fixture

`synthetic-face.png` is an entirely fictional adult portrait generated for this
local software test with OpenAI image generation on 2026-10-12. No real employee,
scraped photograph, identity label or demographic annotation was used. It is a
synthetic test artifact, not an image from the private Cadence documents.

Derivative tiled/rotated images and Office/PDF fixtures are generated locally by
tests. This fixture is used solely to exercise detection and actual pixel blur;
it does not establish accuracy or complete visual privacy coverage.
